usedFor: Pastel holds feedback projects and canvases, and LeadConnector holds the contacts that “Create Or Update Contact” writes.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in Pastel, then “Create Or Update Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: A new project marks a live client, and the action adds or refreshes that contact.

watchOut: “New Project” in Pastel is polling, so the contact is written after a scheduled check.
